results.title: The Million Dollar Cat
results.overview: Tom inherits $1,000,000 from an eccentric aunt on the condition that he not harm any living thing - even a mouse. And guess which mouse keeps following him around and pointing this out to him?

results.title: The Lonesome Mouse
results.overview: Jerry crashes a vase onto Tom's head, which gets Mammy to throw Tom out. Jerry at first revels in his freedom, but soon tires of this, and, under a flag of truce, hatches a plan with Tom.

results.title: Dog Trouble
results.overview: Tom's chasing Jerry when he runs right into a sleeping dog and the two of them must work together to fend him off.

results.title: Puss Gets the Boot
results.overview: Jasper is given an ultimatum by his master: break one more thing and you're out. Rodent Jerry does his best to make sure that his tormentor "gets the boot".

results.title: Let's Stick Together
results.overview: Even with his long white beard and aching back, an aging Donald still has to make ends meet by lancing trash in the park. When he happens upon his old partner, an elderly honey bee named Spike, it conjures up memories of the good ol' days.

results.title: Polka-Dot Puss
results.overview: Tom pretends to have a cold in order to trick Mammy into letting him stay inside for the night. Jerry tricks Tom by making him think he really is sick - with the measles.

results.title: Mice Follies
results.overview: Jerry and his diapered little mouse friend flood the kitchen, then use the freezer to turn it into a skating rink. Even though Tom finds a pair of ice skates, the mice have no problem outmaneuvering him.

results.title: Kitty Foiled
results.overview: Tom subjects Jerry to his usual harassment; but the cat finds a new enemy, and the mouse finds a new friend, in the canary of the house.

results.title: Flirty Birdy
results.overview: Tom is all set to eat Jerry when a hawk swoops down and grabs Jerry. To get Jerry back, Tom poses as a female hawk and quickly finds his new lover to be more than he bargained for.

results.title: Mickey's Steam Roller
results.overview: While streetworker Mickey romances Minnie, Mickey's nephews Morty and Ferdie take control of his steamroller and it's full speed ahead on a very destructive ride.

results.title: Little Quacker
results.overview: Tom steals an egg from a mother duck's nest, but soon the resultant hatchling runs away from the cat and into a mouse hole, where it finds an able protector in Jerry.

results.title: Mouse Cleaning
results.overview: Mammy Two-Shoes threatens to throw Tom out of the house if he makes a mess. Jerry sees an opportunity to rid himself of his feline nemesis.

results.title: Том і Джеррі: політ на Марс
results.original_title: Tom and Jerry Blast Off to Mars!
results.overview: Виходить, що для своїх витівок легендарні Том і Джеррі вже використовували всі можливі місця на нашій старенькій Землі, і тепер веселі звірята вирішують здійснити вояж на Марс, щоб повеселитися там від душі! Ось, правда, марсіани виявилися дрібненькі: малюсінькі гуманоїди. Прийняли Тома за лютого галактичного монстра-велетня і вирішили розправитися з бідолахою, а Джеррі - за легендарного мудреця марсіан. Але, коли їх викривають, Марс атакує! Чи зможуть мишеня і кіт відкласти на якийсь час свої суперечки, щоб врятувати Землю від інопланетного вторгнення? Адже для цього будуть потрібні всі дев'ять життів кота Тома!

results.title: The Mouse Comes to Dinner
results.overview: Tom invites Toots to an elegant dinner. However, he's made the mistake of trying to put Jerry to work, as a serving boy, a corkscrew, and other tasks. Jerry puts up with a little of this, but mostly gets revenge on Tom.

results.title: Том і Джеррі. Чарівник країни Оз
results.original_title: Tom and Jerry & The Wizard of Oz
results.overview: Інтерпретація класичного твору письменника Лаймена Фрэнка Баума «Чарівник з країни Оз». Як завжди не обійшлося без невеликого конфлікту на початку історії, адже Том і Джері все таки кіт і миша, але незабаром їм доведеться забути свої образи і об'єднатися, щоб разом здолати злісну відьму...

results.title: Just Ducky
results.overview: Jerry Mouse befriends a newly hatched duckling who can't swim and ends up protecting him against his feline nemesis, Tom.

results.title: Том і Джеррі: Шпигунські ігри
results.overview: Том і Джеррі веселяться влітку на пляжі, поки не знайомляться зі шпигуном Джонні Квестом. Лиходій доктор Зін викрадає батька Квеста, який знає, як вирішити всі енергетичні складності на планеті. Тепер наші герої повинні здолати загін злісних кішок і відшукати бранця.

results.title: All in a Nutshell
results.overview: Donald steals Chip and Dale's nuts for his nut-butter shop, which is shaped like a giant walnut, Chip and Dale, roll and "shoot" Donald into a nearby lake.

results.title: Jerry and the Lion
results.overview: Jerry agrees to help an escaped circus lion, whose first need is food. But first they'll have to evade Tom, who heard the news bulletin and is armed with a shotgun.

results.title: Cat Napping
results.overview: Tom has plans to take a nice long nap in a hammock, but Jerry has gotten there first and is snoozing happily, so the two fight it out to see who gets to sleep there.
